Hi Vanessa,

We're finalizing our SOC 2 readiness packet for the board (audit window opens 2026-08-15) and need a compact set of artifacts from Redwood to include in the BCP/DR appendix. Can you provide the following by EOD 2026-08-01 if possible: 

- A one-page runbook summary that highlights the failover steps used in a regional outage (core steps, responsible teams, and expected RTO).
- The RTO / RPO matrix tied to customer-impacting services (CSV preferred).
- A key-holder manifest (who has access to KMS / key escrow, escalation contact list, and phone + off-hours contact) in spreadsheet form.
- Date/timestamp of the most recent full recovery exercise and a short note on scope.

Also let us know the secure intake method you prefer (SFTP, secure Drive link, or an upload to our portal). Our security team is CC'd.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Tim

Appreciate the attention to detail — the audit window is tight.
